product.title: Pericol la End House
product.description: Vacanța relaxantă petrecută de Hercule Poirot pe coasta din Cornwell ia o turnură neaşteptată când o cunoaşte pe tânăra şi atrăgătoarea Nick Buckley, căci Poirot are impresia că cineva încearcă să o ucidă pe Nick şi se hotărăşte să-i ofere protecție. Dar nici chiar ascunderea ei într-un azil nu îl împiedică pe asasin să facă o nouă încercare de a-i lua viața tinerei, aşa că Poirot trebuie să recurgă la subterfugii şi viclenie pentru a rezolva acest caz misterios.

# Pericol la End House: A Classic Mystery from Litera

Escape with Hercule Poirot on a captivating journey of suspense and deduction in *Pericol la End House*. This thrilling piece of mystery fiction takes readers far away, promising an unforgettable encounter with classic detective work against a backdrop of coastal intrigue. Perfect for fans of sophisticated whodunnit novels, this book combines relaxation with extreme danger.

## A Mystery Against the Coastline

What starts as a peaceful vacation on the beautiful Cornwell coast swiftly unravels into a deadly game of cat and mouse. Hercule Poirot's relaxing holiday takes an unexpected turn when he meets the young and captivating Nick Buckley. Suddenly, Poirot finds himself convinced that someone is actively trying to kill her, prompting him to step in and offer his protection.

However, the threat proves relentless. Even when Nick is hidden away in a secluded asylum, the determined assassin refuses to give up. *Pericol la End House* keeps the tension high as Poirot must employ all his cunning, stratagems, and clever deductions to solve this deeply mysterious case before another life is lost.

## Why Read This Gripping Mystery Fiction?

If you enjoy meticulously plotted stories where every clue matters, this novel is for you. Litera's *Pericol la End House* showcases Poirot at his most brilliantâa detective forced to operate outside conventional methods to protect the innocent. The blend of cozy location mystery with intense suspense makes it a must-read addition to any fiction collection.

Discover why Hercule Poirotâs intellect is needed when danger lurks around every corner on the Cornwell coast.
